dct_description_sm: Contributors: Universität Bern. Centre for Development and Environment, cartographer

Each sheet contains 3 versions: Landsat background imagery (Landsat Natural Colour RGB Mosaic 2016 (30m) ALOS Terrain, WLRC, and OSM Vector Data 2017); Sentinel imagery (Sentinel False Colour Infrared Mosaic 2017 (10m) ALOS Terrain, WLRC, and OSM Vector Data 2017); WLRC Water and Land Resources Centre basemap (WLRC Land Use/Land Cover 2016).
GeoTIFFs with sidecar metadata files (PRJ, TFW).
Georeferenced TIFF files (viewable in image viewers and correctly projection in GIS). GeoTIFF maps.
Includes 84 sheets total. Three versions for each set of 28 sheets.

Includes 84 sheets total. Three versions for each set of 28 sheets. GeoTIFFs with sidecar metadata files (PRJ, TFW). Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights.
